title: Recurring Expense Visualizer
description: Convert weekly, monthly, and yearly subscriptions into a single unified breakdown of your true annual spending without creating an account.
features: Interactive expense frequency converter across weekly, monthly, and annual totals
Visual category breakdown charts for quick spend analysis
Instant local browser data persistence with CSV/JSON export
target_user: Budget-conscious developers, freelancers, and remote workers tracking personal or business SaaS subscriptions.

why.demand: With 258 total mentions across Hacker News discussions, subscription cost calculation is a heavily discussed pain point within the target demographic.
why.competition: 10 prior Show HN launches signal a crowded market, but most existing tools require account creation or complex bank integrations rather than offering an instant, private, static browser utility.
why.monetization: Integrate non-intrusive affiliate links for business banking/budgeting software, a 'Buy Me a Coffee' donation button, and an email waitlist for a future native desktop menu bar app.

risk_flags: High competition volume with 10 prior Show HN launches
Low user retention as subscription auditing is typically a low-frequency task
review_issues: Missing closing </html> — output may be truncated.
The HTML document is truncated and cuts off abruptly inside the <style> block at line 470.
Missing HTML <body> content and markup for all dashboard components, forms, and tables.
Missing JavaScript logic entirely; interactive frequency converter (weekly/monthly/annual) is not implemented.
Missing chart rendering logic for visual category spend breakdowns.
Missing local storage persistence and CSV/JSON export functionality.
